title: Adversarial Testing of Automated Program Repair Agents for Security Vulnerabilities
abstract: arXiv:2609.15963v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Software agents with Large Language Models (LLMs) are designed for Automated Program Repair (APR) tasks, raising the possibility that, in the near future, APR agents will fix bugs automatically without much human intervention. Can we trust an APR agent to produce both functionally correct and secure code in such situations? What if attackers target production APR agents with adversarial issues that seem benign but may influence the agents to produce correct but insecure code? In this paper, we took a first step towards answering these questions by conducting an empirical study. First, we created SWEADV, a benchmark of 750 adversarial issue descriptions constructed from 150 repair tasks in SWE-bench Verified. For each repair task, we created five adversarial issue descriptions, one for each attack type: command execution, deserialization, path traversal, denial of service, and weak hashing. translated_title: 面向安全漏洞的自动程序修复智能体对抗性测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的软件智能体被设计用于自动程序修复（APR）任务，这使得在不久的将来，APR智能体能够在几乎没有人工干预的情况下自动修复缺陷成为可能。在这种情况下，我们能否信任APR智能体生成既功能正确又安全可靠的代码？如果攻击者向生产环境的APR智能体注入看似良性、但可能诱导智能体生成功能正确却不安全的代码的对抗性问题，又会发生什么？在本文中，我们通过开展实证研究迈出了回答这些问题的第一步。首先，我们创建了SWEADV，这是一个包含750条对抗性问题描述的基准数据集，基于SWE-bench Verified中的150个修复任务构建而成。针对每个修复任务，我们创建了五条对抗性问题描述，分别对应五种攻击类型：命令执行、反序列化、路径遍历、拒绝服务和弱哈希。其次，我们评估了来自……的mini_swe APR智能体。
tldr: 本文提出了首个针对自动程序修复（APR）智能体的对抗性安全测试基准SWEADV，通过750条看似良性的对抗性问题（涵盖命令执行、反序列化、路径遍历、拒绝服务和弱哈希五种攻击类型），实证研究了攻击者如何诱导APR智能体生成功能正确但存在安全漏洞的代码。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SWEADV, the first adversarial security testing benchmark for Automated Program Repair (APR) agents, comprising 750 seemingly benign adversarial issue descriptions across five attack types, and empirically investigates how attackers can trick APR agents into producing functionally correct but insecure code.
